releaseNotes: Automated Utah permit routing by extracting the UTCVIEW permit number, printed origin and destination GPS coordinates, and every printed route leg for review.
Added secure New Mexico official-route retrieval by permit number, including state-source response hashing and immutable audit provenance.
Preserved disconnected official route sections across map preview and navigation, with clear section-complete guidance instead of routing across gaps.
Added each user’s installed app version and build number to the administrator directory.
Redesigned the public download website with the live APK link, complete changelog, and a secure permit-research submission form.
